title: Mahoowo kisndam tiiɗɗo
intro: Limre muñal mawngal e hoolaare nde ustataako, oo neɗɗo waɗii duuɓi keewɗi e golle diine, ina jokkondiri e majjere e jaɓgol ngol alaa ɗo haaɗi. Daartol maɓɓe ko seedantaagal doolewal wonande goonɗinal e yeeso majjere mawnde, haa arti noon e kewu maantinngu, mbayliigu aduna.
clues: Mi hokki wakkati juutɗum masin nder ngeedam am ngam noddugo lenyol am ngam dewal Allah.
Yimɓe am ina njaltina mi, ina tuuma mi e majjere laaɓtunde e majjere.
Mi yamiraama mahde huunde nde nanndaani e renndo am ngo alaa ko woni e mum so wonaa leydi.
Ko seeɗa tan ngoongɗini, njokkondiri e am e ɓesngu am e ndee mahdi keeriindi.
Miɗo joginoo kala tagoore wuurnde e nder laana kaa, no Alla yamiri nii.
Ilam mawɗam ɓuuɓni leydi ndii, hisni tan ko wonduɓe e am e nder laana am, ɓiɗɗo am oo majjii sabu majjere mum.
arabic: مِّمَّا خَطِيٓـَٔـٰتِهِمْ أُغْرِقُوا۟ فَأُدْخِلُوا۟ نَارًۭا فَلَمْ يَجِدُوا۟ لَهُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَنصَارًۭا
verse: Because of their sins they were drowned and put into the Fire, and they found not for themselves besides Allāh [any] helpers. (71:25)
